# Heading

A heading's text style, independent of the HTML tag it renders. The tag tracks the ambient level from `HeadingContextProvider`, so moving a heading to a different place in the page never requires touching its `size`.

**Import:** `import { Heading } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Heading/Heading.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Heading/Heading.stories.jsx` — Overview, Sizes, OverridesTheTag, NestedContext, InverseColor, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, NotAControl

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Heading/Heading.mdx`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `as` | enum | — | Overrides the HTML element the heading renders as. |
| `size` | enum | — | The text style. Required: a heading with no size is not a heading. |
| `color` | enum | — | Applies inverse text color automatically when the ground is dark. |
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `testId` | string | — | — |
| `children` | node (required) | — | — |

## Variants

**`as`** — `div` · `h1` · `h2` · `h3` · `h4` · `h5` · `h6` · `span`

**`size`** — `xxlarge` · `xlarge` · `large` · `medium` · `small` · `xsmall` · `xxsmall`

**`color`** — `color.text` · `color.text.inverse` · `color.text.warning.inverse`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
